note: Recorded from the hand-written pack in the commit that deleted it. Every expectation describes that pack, not the real service; a probe run replaces cells with observed evidence and cites the cassette. The pack never faults, so there are no fault expectations; reads of absent records answer empty bodies or stock defaults and are gated as such. Where the pack answered records under members the response shape does not declare -- the whole generic-handler family -- the bundle answers the declared member or shape and the step or member is superseded with that reason.
